_note: Final thesis item F4.2 - mechanical design of the conveyor modules CC (chain zone), TU (chain/roller transfer with lift), RCX / RL (chain-driven live roller zones). Values = DESIGN values; catalogue values = REFERENCE (ISO 606, ISO 15, typical catalogue classes) [verify with the supplier]. Tool: conv_mech.py. Guide: Doctor paper/61 chapters 11-20.

crate._base: two runners 1200 long along the L side at +-350 mm (2-way base): the central telescopic fork of the F3 crane (450 mm wide) enters from the 800 side through the 600 mm opening between the runners; runners cross the CHAINS when the crate travels 800-leading and cross the ROLLERS when it travels 1200-leading. Total crate height 600 mm INCLUDING the 160 mm runners (= F3).

_uneven_note: a crate base is never flat: design load per contact = static share x 2 (one diagonal pair carries more)

chain_cc.guide: UHMW-PE wear strip on steel C-profile
chain_cc._f_note: chain rollers rolling on the wear strip under load (top strand) and chain sliding on the return strip; values = design values incl. dirt

_chain_note: ISO 606 B-series simplex: pitch p, roller d1, inner width b1, pin d2, bearing area A, minimum breaking load FB, mass q - catalogue mid values [verify]; minimum for pallet conveyors in this design: 12B (robustness against fork / AGV impact)

rollers._bearing: deep groove ball bearings 6203 / 6204 / 6205 in the roller ends (C, ISO 281) [verify]
rollers._f: rolling resistance crate runner on steel roller incl. roller bearings (design value)
rollers._tube_min: robustness minimum for 300 kg crates with steel runners: dent resistance at AGV / fork impact and end-stop shocks (heavy pallet roller class); load alone would allow 50 x 1.5
rollers._length: 1200-leading: the crate is 800 wide across the rollers -> 1000 mm rollers (800 + 2 x 100 for guides and AGV docking tolerance)

_ucp: insert bearing units (pillow block, ISO 9628 class) C = basic dynamic load rating [verify]

tu._note: TU = chain conveyor section (x, 800-leading, as CC) + roller set (y, 1200-leading) lifted 30 mm above the chains by two eccentric shafts coupled by a chain, one brake gear motor; roller set: 8 rollers, chain-driven, own gear motor

frame._I: C 160x60x5: web 5x160^3/12 = 1.71e6 + flanges 2 x 300 x 77.5^2 = 3.6e6 -> 5.5e6 mm4 (hand value, check the supplier table)

_rcx: Z31 fits between TU1 and TU2 (y = +-1400, TU outer half-width 720 -> 1360 free): 1340 mm with 9 rollers (found by the 3D model)
